summary: Shared Codex final-message capture pattern (-o outfile probe/fallback) plus review/consult telemetry and contracts shared by agents/reviewer.md, agents/consultant-primary.md, and agents/consultant-secondary.md.

entry_points.summary: Exactly one of intent_snapshot/ledger_path present returns BLOCKED.
Reviewer artifact dir under plan archive tasks.
Reviewer minors/nits routed to follow-up sink.
Primary consultant persona contract is freeform.
Secondary consultant persona contract is freeform.

invariants: Only provider==codex with a positive output-last-message probe uses -o file capture.
Probe sentinel is keyed on PPID, not $$.
Fallback emits review_capture_fallback before stdout retry.
Reviewer INTENT mode requires both intent_snapshot and ledger_path.
Reviewer minors/nits must be represented in FOLLOWUPS rather than silently dropped.
All three agents call log-subagent.sh after capture.
Reviewer response_chars/artifact are sourced from the captured final message, never the discarded codex transcript.
gotchas: Reviewer and consultant archive paths differ (task archive dir vs run transcripts dir).
Codex non-zero exit invalidates outfile and triggers fallback even if a partial file exists.
Z_HARNESS_PLAN_DIR is required for reviewer artifact path construction.
Consultants use freeform contract; reviewer uses review-verdict contract.
Entry-point line numbers in the human doc drift whenever these three templated agent files are edited; re-verify with grep -n before trusting cited lines.
Repo migrated commands/ -> skills/ as the single source (skills-removed-single-source); consumed_by lists skill slugs, not command paths.
